epics.title: Real-Time Multiplayer Core
epics.description: Develop the core networking and matchmaking infrastructure to support low-latency, cross-platform multiplayer gameplay, ensuring seamless player connections, dynamic matchmaking, and robust session management.
epics.business_value: Provides a high-quality, engaging player experience that drives retention, increases in-game purchases, and supports scalable growth across PC, console, and mobile platforms.
